map.算法：有效功率 Ph = ρgQH/3.6e6（kW）；轴功率 Psh = Ph: Algorithm: effective power Ph = ρgQH/3.6e6 (kW); shaft power Psh = Ph/η; motor Pm = Psh × safety factor; specific speed ns = 3.65×1450×√(Q/3.6/1000)/H^0.75 (Q in m³/h).
map.例：流量 50m³/h、扬程 30m、清水(ρ=1000)、效率 75%、安全系: Example: flow 50 m³/h, head 30 m, fresh water (ρ=1000), efficiency 75%, safety factor 1.15 → effective 4.09 kW, shaft 5.45 kW, motor 6.27 kW, specific speed 48.7. If flow 100, head 50, efficiency 80%, factor 1.2 → effective 13.63 kW, motor 20.44 kW, specific speed 46.9.
map.扬程和流量怎么定？: How to determine head and flow?
map.由管路曲线（沿程+局部阻力+高差）与需求流量交点定；须留 10~20% 余量，避: Set by the intersection of the pipe curve (friction + local loss + elevation) and the required flow; keep a 10%~20% margin to avoid oversizing or underloading.
map.比转速小说明什么？: What does a small specific speed mean?
map.ns 小（如 <80）多为低比转速离心泵，高扬程小流量；ns 大则大流量低扬程。: Small ns (e.g. <80) is mostly a low-ns centrifugal with high head and low flow; larger ns means high flow and low head. Select so the design ns matches the model's high-efficiency zone.
